cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.

mechanism: A directs holiday recovery by treating a failed sunny forecast as a prediction of refund happiness, adjusting practical responsibility to keep B involved.
confusable: Generic optimism does not insist the same earlier prediction was already correct under a new interpretation.
comparison: Flood alternative uses ambiguous social wording; this one confronts a plainly wrong weather forecast and a refund task.
seedUse: Sunny/sunscreen seed supplies challenged wording; keep all callback language established before the ending and attach the certainty to actual recovery work.
